changes.comment: BREAKING: ITaskWriteGuard.guard now answers PromiseLike<Result<T>>, so AsyncControl.WriteGate from @fgv/ts-extras fits TaskBroker.create({ writeGuard }) as is; every existing gate still fits. A section the guard started and that then rejected (including a withWriter that throws synchronously) is storage-unavailable with retry reconcile-first, as is a guard that ran the section and then answered something that is not a Result. A guard that answers success or a non-Result without running the section is invalid. A refusal from a guard that never ran the section keeps its failure only when the detail converts as an ITaskFailure, which is checked structurally; otherwise it is storage-unavailable with retry after-host-action. Fix: createNative and registerExternal answer invalid when a retried attempt again finds nothing to report, instead of recursing. On release, a guard that answered success without running the section made that recursion unbounded, as microtasks, and hung the process. TaskScheduleTimer is removed: TaskBroker.create({ schedule }) takes AsyncControl.ScheduleTimer, which is structurally identical.
